title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Indicators That Earn Their Place

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of the 200 EMA in trading?
options: To act as a dynamic stop-loss level
To define the long-term trend bias, with price above it favoring longs
questions.explanation: The 200 EMA serves as a big-picture trend baseline; price above it suggests a bullish bias.

questions.text: Using both a 20 EMA and a 200 EMA on the same chart is unnecessary because they provide identical information.
questions.explanation: The 20 EMA captures short-term dynamics while the 200 EMA reflects the long-term trend; they are not duplicates.
